nom: ROSEN Super Smoothie Cleanser for Preventing Dark Spots and Minor Breakouts

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers say the cleanser removes excess oil and exfoliates well without stripping their natural oils.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dry-combination skin report it cleans without stripping, tightening, or leaving a dry film, though one 2-star reviewer felt it left a dry residue afterward.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (including oily T-zone/dry cheeks) describe balanced results, smoother texture, and no tight or stripped feeling.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation and gentle exfoliation, with one long-term user calling it non-irritating despite natural ingredients.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal-to-dry skin says it cleans well with no residue and helps with chin breakouts.
segments.mature: A 46-year-old reviewer with sensitive/dry skin reports brighter skin and no irritation after a week of use.

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer reports the cleanser helped with dark spots from aging alongside hormonal acne; no other aging-specific comments appear.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it does not strip or dry the skin and even feels hydrating, but one 2-star review reports a dry film left after washing.
concerns.redness: One reviewer noted her skin was less red and irritated the morning after first use; this is the only direct mention of redness.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers say the light exfoliating beads do not damage or wreck the skin barrier, describing it as soothing rather than harsh.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fading of dark spots and hyperpigmentation within days to weeks; a few see no change in dark spots or hyperpigmentation even after weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority describe reduced breakouts, fewer bumps, and calmer hormonal or cystic acne over one to several weeks; a small minority report new breakouts or bumps appearing shortly after first use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers say it exfoliates and cleans thoroughly without stripping or over-drying their natural oil.

aspects.libelle: Short shelf life, retailer stock often expired

extraits.texte: I'm so upset, I know trying new face products can be risky and it can definitely be expected that a new product might make you 'purge' or irritate your existing acne, but it is very much unexpected to develop new zits almost immediately after use in a place that you NEVER breakout and have never had any skincare issues with. about 1 hour after use i have 4 bumps on my neck which is an area I've never had acne. I'm also noticing new small bumps all over my face. I'm so sad and scared, and worried that I'm about to develop a rash or something :( so upsetting as i have slowly been making progress on my acne over the years. My skin looks terrible right now I'm so devastated. This is after only one use, please stay away its not worth the risk. I will literally be crying myself to sleep tonight.

I really wanted to try this cleaner. I have noticed a difference in my skin since using for about a month now, so I do like it. Feels very clean and moisturized without stripping my skin. I like the light exfoliation in. The smell is god awful. I expected it to be more fruity but to me it's smells like sweet potatoes. I have gotten used to it, but I don't think I will repurchase just because of the smell. Also, small bottle. I don't feel like I really need to use a big amount but after using morning and night consistently I'm already almost out.

Yes it has an odd smell but I would rather have that than irritating fragrance added. I used a sample I received of this and in the am I couldn't believe how bright my skin looked after one use. I love the texture of this and it is not at all drying. I've been using now for a week with no irritation to my sensitive and dry 46 year old skin. I will be purchasing the full size and maybe trying some other products from this line.

I received a trial size of this in a goodie bag from ULTA. I never would have sought out this product on my own, and so far I am loving it! It's such a gentle exfoliation and I watched it literally take my mascara right off my eyelashes and eye area. Some people mention a smell but I have sniffed it several times and can't really smell anything. It washes off very clean with no left behind residue. My skin looks healthier and almost a little glow-y, and my pores look better too. My face feels refreshed instead of dry afterwards. I'm 34 with combo skin (oily t-zone but dry cheeks) and this face wash really seems like an overall winner!

This has been the best for my skin. Very hydrating, silky and I love the smell. I have dry combination skin. Everything is dry but my nose. I typically end my day with oil literally sitting on my nose and the rest of my face having kind of gloss over it. Since I started using this over a year ago it's been a balanced, even glow.
When I tell u im obsessed…this cleanser feels amazing on my skin (I have sensitive skin) it delicately exfoliates and leaves skin refreshed and clean. Its totally a must have.

I am obsessed with this cleanser. This brand is by a Black Woman and it's so refreshing that we now have products geared towards specific skincare issues POC have in stores. I am ALWAYSSSSS looking for something for hyperpigmentation. I have cleared so much of my old hyperpigmentation up; but it's an ongoing thing. I'll always battle with it because that's just how my skin is. If I have any little bump on my face it will most likely leave a scar. So I'm always looking for things to include in my skincare routine that will handle that. My skin has really been through it the last few months due to alot of things I've been personally going through. I needed something that would REALLY help my skin out and this brand DEFINITELY did that. I'm honestly floored with how much I love everything. The Super Smoothie cleanser is a standout favorite. I have many face washes that I love but this one is truly at the top for me. It's a 'non stripping cleanser for dark spots and textured skin' I have never had a cleanser that made my skins texture even out so much after just one wash. It also isn't too drying for my normal to dry skin. It also brightened my skin so much after one wash. I'm not joking when I say some of my hyperpigmentation cleared up so fast with this cleanser I was shook. This stuff is magic, straight up. I really love it.
